capabilities.label: GL/chart of accounts
capabilities.detail: double-entry GL, default chart by business type (customizable), journal entries (single/compound/recurring), tracking categories (department/location), role-based access (Standard/Invoice Only/Read-only/Adviser/Administrator), find-and-recode

capabilities.label: Invoicing/AR
capabilities.detail: customizable branded online invoices, recurring/repeating invoices, automated overdue reminders (dunning), real-time payment status, "pay now" links, multi-currency invoicing, customer statements, aged receivables, partial payments/overpayments, quote-to-invoice

capabilities.label: Quotes
capabilities.detail: create/send quotes, templates, convert accepted quotes to invoices, status tracking

capabilities.label: Bill pay/AP
capabilities.detail: enter & track bills with due dates, bill approval workflows, batch/scheduled payments, email-to-bills (PDF capture), supplier management, aged payables, Bill Pay (US, card/ACH)
features: enter & track bills with due dates

capabilities.label: Expense management (Xero Expenses)
capabilities.detail: dedicated app, receipt photo capture, employee expense claims & reimbursement, mileage/spending claims, expense reports, approvals (Established plan)

capabilities.label: Bank reconciliation
capabilities.detail: automatic daily bank feeds, statement-line auto-matching, pattern-learning suggestions, bank rules, bulk/auto reconciliation, cash coding, multi-bank connectivity

capabilities.label: Reporting
capabilities.detail: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, aged receivables/payables, sales/tax reports, customizable reports with tracking categories, real-time KPI dashboard, data export

capabilities.label: Budgeting/FP&A (Analytics/Analytics Plus)
capabilities.detail: budget manager & variance reporting, 30-day short-term cash flow forecast, extended forecasting (90/180 days, Analytics Plus), business snapshot, what-if scenario planning

capabilities.label: Multi-currency
capabilities.detail: 160+ currencies (Established), daily rate updates, multi-currency invoices/bills/payments, realized/unrealized FX, base-currency consolidation

capabilities.label: Tax/GST/VAT
capabilities.detail: sales tax setup & tracking, automated tax calc, GST/VAT return reporting, W-9 and 1099 management (US)

capabilities.label: Payroll
capabilities.detail: in-region Xero Payroll (UK/AU/NZ — pay runs, payslips, tax filing, leave, pensions/super, self-service); US payroll via native Gusto integration
features: in-region Xero Payroll (UK/AU/NZ — pay runs, payslips, tax filing, leave, pensions/super, self-service); US payroll via native Gusto integration

capabilities.label: Payments

capabilities.label: Inventory
capabilities.detail: track stock items, buy/sell price management, auto stock updates, low-stock alerts, inventory reporting (advanced needs third-party app)

capabilities.label: Projects/job costing (Xero Projects)
capabilities.detail: project tracking, timesheets, cost/expense assignment, budgets, planned-vs-actual, project quotes/invoicing, profitability reports

capabilities.label: POs/fixed assets
capabilities.detail: create/send POs, PO-to-bill matching; fixed asset register, depreciation, disposals

capabilities.label: Contacts/CRM-lite
capabilities.detail: customer & supplier database, contact groups, per-contact transaction history, smart lists

capabilities.label: Integrations/App Store
capabilities.detail: 1,000+ app marketplace, open REST API, native Shopify; Gusto, Stripe/GoCardless/Square, ApprovalMax, Dext; Xero HQ / Practice Manager

capabilities.label: Hubdoc (all plans)
capabilities.detail: automatic bill/receipt data capture, document storage, publish-to-Xero as coded transactions

capabilities.label: Mobile
capabilities.detail: Xero Accounting, Xero Me (payroll/self-service/timesheets), Expenses and Projects apps
